description: This file defines a mock class 'GstGenericPlayerMock' for the 'IGstGenericPlayer' interface, used for unit testing within the Rialto media server component. It includes mock method declarations for media player operations such as attachSource, play, pause, stop, setVolume, and others.

classes.name: GstGenericPlayerMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IGstGenericPlayer interface for testing purposes.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Mocks attaching a media source to the player.

methods.name: removeSource
methods.description: Mocks removing a media source from the player.

methods.name: allSourcesAttached
methods.description: Mocks signaling that all sources are attached.

methods.name: attachSamples
methods.description: Mocks attaching media samples or segments.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the current playback position.

methods.name: setVideoGeometry
methods.description: Mocks setting the video display geometry.

methods.name: setMute
methods.description: Mocks muting or unmuting the audio.
